title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 7

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the version-control class take place?
tasks.audioText: The software systems class will review version records on Monday at one. Students should bring the sample change log and meet in the computer laboratory. The instructor will explain how a version number, release date and change summary help users identify the correct software edition. Students will compare two example records.

tasks.prompt: Which record should students bring for the version-control class?
tasks.audioText: The software systems class will review version records on Monday at one. Students should bring the sample change log and meet in the computer laboratory. The instructor will explain how a version number, release date and change summary help users identify the correct software edition. Students will compare two example records.

tasks.prompt: A change log records updates made to a software product. It may list the version number, release date and a summary of changes or corrections. When a user reports a problem, the support team may ask which version is installed. This information helps the team compare the report with known issues and decide whether an update is relevant. Reading 1. What may a change log include?
options: Supplier address, purchase price and order quantity
Machine serial number, operator name and shift date
Version number, release date and a summary of changes
Equipment colour, storage location and maintenance cost

tasks.prompt: Why might support staff ask for the installed version?
options: To replace the need for a technical support record
To identify the person who purchased the equipment
To calculate the machine's operating speed
To compare the problem with known issues and relevant updates

tasks.prompt: The installed version ___ in the support request.
Choose TWO details that help identify a software release.
options: The colour of the desktop background

tasks.prompt: A record of changes made between software releases is a change ___.
A support technician asks which version you use. What should you provide?
options: I do not know, but it is probably the newest.
I can provide the version number and release date shown in the system information.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of software version control in a logical order.
options: Check the release date or change log
Include the details in the support request
correctOrder: Check the release date or change log
Include the details in the support request

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why software version information is important when reporting a technical problem.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains why software version information belongs in a technical problem report (0–2); it links version details to reproducibility, compatibility or troubleshooting and identifies the relevant system/software (0–2); the explanation is clear with understandable grammar (0–2); software/version-control vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
